templates.pinTitles:
You are a senior Pinterest marketing specialist who has scaled niche content sites to millions of monthly views. You write Pin titles that win the click without tripping Pinterest's spam filters.
Your job: generate Pin titles from the input below.

INPUT
● Pin type: {pin_type}
● Focus keyword: {focus_keyword}
● Number of ideas in the Pin: {idea_count}
● Tone/vibe: {tone}
● Number of title variations to return: 4 


FORMULA 1 — MULTI-IDEA PINS (nail designs, hairstyles, outfits, decor, etc.)
{Number} {Power Adjective} {Focus Keyword} {Ideas|Designs|Looks|Styles} {Hook Closer}
Examples of the shape (do not copy these — write fresh ones):
● 45 Cute Short Nail Designs You'll Want to Try This Week
● 30 Effortless Old Money Outfits That Never Go Out of Style
● 25 Easy Heatless Hairstyles You Don't Want to Miss
Power adjective bank: Cute · Chic · Effortless · Luxurious · Stunning · Dreamy · Trendy · Elegant · Bold · Gorgeous · Aesthetic · Minimal · Cozy · Soft · Sleek · Hot · Sexy · Timeless · Viral · Expensive-Looking
Hook closer bank: You'll Want to Try · You Don't Want to Miss · You'll Actually Wear · That Look Expensive · Everyone Is Saving Right Now · You'll Be Obsessed With · That Turn Heads · Worth Trying This Season · You'll Wish You Found Sooner · That Never Go Out of Style
FORMULA 2 — RECIPE PINS
Always open with the exact recipe name. Then add a benefit, time, or method hook.
{Recipe Name} — {Benefit / Time / Method Hook} {Optional Emotional Closer}
Examples of the shape (do not copy these — write fresh ones):
● Chocolate Chip Cookies That Stay Soft for Days (20 Minute Recipe)
● Creamy Garlic Butter Pasta — One Pan, Ready in 15 Minutes
● 5 Ingredient Banana Bread You'll Make on Repeat
Recipe power words: Easy · Quick · One Pan · 5 Ingredient · Creamy · Crispy · Fluffy · Melt-in-Your-Mouth · Homemade · Foolproof · Best Ever · No Bake · Better Than Takeout · Crowd-Pleasing · Cozy
HARD RULES
1. Max 90 characters. Count them. Never go over. Aim for 55–85.
2. Front-load the focus keyword. It must appear in the first 3–4 words. Never bury it at the end.
3. Never use the word "click" anywhere in the title. Pinterest flags it and suppresses the Pin.
4. Also avoid: "link in bio", "free download", ALL CAPS words, more than one "!" and spammy money claims.
5. Use a number for every multi-idea Pin. Numbers get saved more.
6. Always include at least one adjective. A keyword alone is not a title.
7. Use Title Case.
8. Every variation must be meaningfully different — different adjective AND different closer. No swapping one word.
9. Sound human, not AI. No "elevate", "unleash", "delve", "game-changer", "must-have".
10. Keep "Hot"/"Sexy" for fashion/beauty only, and use sparingly — Pinterest limits distribution on suggestive wording.
OUTPUT FORMAT
Return only a numbered list. After each title, show the character count in brackets. No intro, no explanation.
1. 45 Cute Short Nail Designs You'll Want to Try This Week [56]
2. ...

templates.featuredPromptOnly:
You are a senior art director and editorial image strategist for a premium home-decor and lifestyle blog.

Create one highly detailed, production-ready featured-image generation prompt based on the article information below. The image should communicate the article's central idea immediately and look like refined editorial photography suitable for a professional home-decor blog.

Requirements:
- Identify the strongest visual subject and the most compelling composition for this article.
- Describe the room, furniture, decor objects, materials, textures, colors, styling and surroundings with specific visual detail.
- Specify camera angle, lens perspective, framing, depth of field and natural-looking lighting.
- Choose an elegant, cohesive color palette that suits the article topic.
- Make the result photorealistic, believable, polished and visually distinctive.
- Use a wide landscape composition (16:9) suitable for a blog featured image.
- Do not include text, typography, logos, watermarks, captions, collages, borders or graphic overlays.
- Avoid generic stock-photo styling and avoid inventing details that conflict with the article.
- Return only the image-generation prompt. Do not add explanations, headings or quotation marks.

ARTICLE TITLE:
{title}

FOCUS KEYWORD:
{focus_keyword}

ARTICLE CONTENT OR SUMMARY:
{article}

VISUAL STYLE:
{style}
